spec: Header X-Govder-Tenant-Assertion: <seg0>.<seg1>.<seg2>.<mac> (exactly four segments split on '.').
seg0 = base64url without padding of the tenant's UTF-8 bytes, canonical (no '=', zero trailing bits). The tenant is non-empty, valid UTF-8, and has no byte below 0x20 and no 0x7f.
seg1 = expiry, unix seconds, canonical decimal: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$ and at most 2^63-1. No sign, no leading zero.
seg2 = jti: ^[0-9a-f]{16}$ (64 bits from a CSPRNG, lowercase hex). Every signer emits it and every verifier enforces it.
mac = base64url without padding of HMAC-SHA256(key, payload), canonical (43 characters).
payload = seg0 '.' seg1 '.' seg2 LF ascii_upper(method) LF path LF query LF ascii_lower(host) LF base64url_nopad(sha256(body)).
ascii_upper and ascii_lower change only the ASCII letters A-Z and a-z; every other byte is kept.

path is the path of the request-target EXACTLY as transmitted: percent-encoding kept byte for byte (no decoding, no re-encoding, no case change of hex digits, no dot-segment removal). A signer signs the path it puts on the wire; a verifier uses the raw path it received.
query is the raw query as transmitted, without the '?' (empty when absent).
host is the Host header value (authority), compared after ascii_lower.
verify.expected_tenant is the tenant a verifier that is told which tenant to expect (vultrino) is configured with; govder derives the tenant and must return exactly the vector's tenant on accept.

A verifier rejects unless: the grammar above holds, the MAC matches one accepted key (constant-time), now <= exp, and exp - now <= max_ttl_s. A max TTL of zero or less is a configuration error: the verifier applies its default ceiling, never no ceiling.
Replay is verifier policy and not in these vectors: govder consumes (seg0, jti) until exp; vultrino's approval route relies on the one-way approval transition.
consumers: govder pkg/tenantassert (Go signer and verifier) and internal/httpx (verifier middleware)
feir-os app/internal/crypto (LocalSigner, KMSSigner) over the vendored pkg/tenantassert

reasons.bad_mac: no accepted key produces the MAC

vectors.note: plain GET, no query, empty body
POST with a JSON body bound by its digest
percent-encoding in the query is kept as sent
the signer's method is ASCII-uppercased in the payload
host is ASCII-lowercased on both sides
ascii_lower keeps non-ASCII: U+212A KELVIN SIGN is not lowered to k
an id containing '/' travels as %2F and is signed raw (GVF-11)
an id containing a space travels as %20 and is signed raw (XV-07)
lowercase hex digits in a percent-escape are kept as sent
the approval decision route as the broker signs it
exp - now == max TTL is still valid
signed over the DECODED path, sent raw with %2F: different paths
signed single-escaped, sent double-escaped (%252F): different paths
signed with a key the verifier does not hold
exp grammar has no leading zero
a C0 control byte in the tenant
the tenant bytes are not UTF-8
nonzero trailing bits in the MAC
